data.summary: The opening reproduces the first multi-view character sheet and dissolves into the street instead of showing exactly two fighters in one continuous shot. A single swing and block then occur, but the camera pushes into a cropped upper-body view. The final two blades are readable and remain clear of the faces.

observations.text: The first reference sheet, including several views of one woman, occupies the opening. It dissolves into the street while the sheet figures linger as ghosted extras.
Two fighters approach and perform one diagonal swing/block, with contact near 2.9 s. The camera begins a substantial push-in.
The crossed silver and blue weapons are distinct, but the legs and then lower bodies are outside the image. This fails the required full-body continuous lateral composition.

data.review_scope: All 120 sequential thumbnails and original frames 0, 71 and 119 inspected against the three original references. No listening or normal-speed playback judgment.
